## Notes

- **No knowledge graph.** `graphify-out/graph.json` is absent (install failed per the
  task brief) — this report is a textual scan, not graph-derived.
- **Single stack, confirmed.** Root `package.json` is the only manifest in the scanned
  tree (`dependencies`: `next@16.3.1`, `react@19.2.8`, `react-dom@19.2.8`;
  `devDependencies`: `@playwright/test`, `tailwindcss@4`, `typescript@5`, `eslint@9`).
  No `composer.json`, `Gemfile`, `pyproject.toml`, `pom.xml`/`build.gradle`, `go.mod`, or
  `Cargo.toml` anywhere under `app/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `e2e/`. No `[MULTI_STACK]`
  flag needed.
- **No backend confirmed.** No `middleware.ts` source file exists (only build artifacts
  under `.next/`, which is excluded per scope). No `app/api/**/route.ts` route handlers.
  No database client, ORM, ODM, or ENV-based connection string beyond
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` display/config values in `.env.example`. This is a static/client-only
  marketing homepage, consistent with the task brief.
- **BL near-miss, rejected.** `components/home/countdown-timer.tsx:35` calls
  `setInterval(tick, 60_000)` to re-render the countdown display every minute. This is a
  client-side UI refresh tick, not a canonical BL type (no server process, no recurring
  job outside the browser tab, disappears on tab close) — does not match the
  `scheduled-job` intent ("cron-like scheduled tasks"). Not counted; flagged here per the
  audit trail expectation rather than silently dropped.
- **Session/role source is a client-side mock, not a permission boundary.**
  `lib/session/session-provider.tsx` carries an explicit in-file warning: `role` and
  `unreadCount` are read from `localStorage`/`NEXT_PUBLIC_*` env vars, editable from
  DevTools, with no backend and no server-side check anywhere. It is tagged `permission`
  in the File Inventory because it is the sole source of role-conditional UI (consumed
  by `components/ui/account-menu.tsx` and `components/ui/notification-bell.tsx`, and
  referenced by `app/admin/page.tsx`'s comment: "the account menu links here for the
  `admin` role only") — but downstream artifacts (permissions-template, permissions-
  matrix) MUST record this as UI-only gating, not enforced authorization. No
  server-side permission/policy/gate/auth file exists anywhere in the scanned tree.
- **`lib/awards.ts` tagged `model`** — it defines the `Award` interface plus the
  hard-coded `AWARDS: Award[]` constant (6 static award categories) and the
  `awardHref()` slug→URL derivation. This is the closest thing to a data model in a
  backend-less app: an in-code static dataset, not a runtime schema.
- **Layout and stylesheet tagged `other`** — `app/layout.tsx` (root layout wrapping
  `SessionProvider`/`LocaleProvider`, no own route segment) and `app/globals.css`
  (Tailwind v4 CSS-first entrypoint) don't fit `screen`/`route`/`config` cleanly; `other`
  is the least-wrong bucket per the template's type legend.
- **`app/favicon.ico` excluded from File Inventory.** It is a binary asset, not source;
  same treatment the task brief specifies for `public/` binaries (one-line count is
  enough). One file, no further action.
- **Test files excluded from File Inventory per template contract** (`## File Inventory`
  is "One entry per non-test, non-vendor source file"): `lib/awards.test.ts`,
  `lib/countdown.test.ts`, and 8 Playwright specs under `e2e/`
  (`homepage-awards-grid.spec.ts`, `homepage-countdown.spec.ts`,
  `homepage-dropdown-menus.spec.ts`, `homepage-invalid-env.spec.ts`,
  `homepage-navigation.spec.ts`, `homepage-role-gating.spec.ts`,
  `homepage-structure-and-copy.spec.ts`, `homepage-widget-and-kudos.spec.ts`).
  `e2e/support/seed-defaults.ts` is a test-support helper, not itself a spec, so it is
  included in the inventory as `other`.
- **Two test runners, one Playwright install** — `test:unit` runs
  `playwright test --config playwright.unit.config.ts` (drives `lib/*.test.ts`, pure-
  function unit tests for `awards.ts`/`countdown.ts`) while `test:e2e` runs the default
  `playwright.config.ts` against `e2e/*.spec.ts`. Both configs exist at root and were
  scanned as config files.
- **Routing confirmed.** Six routes total: `/` (`app/page.tsx`), `/awards`, `/kudos`,
  `/profile`, `/admin` (all `page.tsx` under their own directory) — no
  `not-found.tsx`/`app/_not-found` file was actually found in the scanned tree despite

  route from `app/layout.tsx` when no custom file is present, so there is nothing to
  inventory for it. Flagged for the researcher to confirm this is expected rather than a
  missing file.
- **Env surface** — `.env.example` declares only `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` keys (client-visible),
